items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It had Mert Oliver on bass... These were all brilliant musicians. They had a small band together. They played Cavacas Grill. I knew Don Lamond way back then.

ctx.x: Yeah. Washington, D.C., had Don Lamond. It had Mert Oliver on bass, Angelo Tompros on tenor saxophoners, and Earl Swope on trombone, Marky Markowitz on trumpet. These were all brilliant musicians. They had a small band together. They played Cavacas Grill. I knew Don Lamond way back then. He was a great player. I never heard him play with a big band. This was like an octet. Later on I caught him with Woody [Herman]’s band, and he blew me away. Sounded great. Technique was there. Sound was there. Able to listen.…
No. This one – I just know the three of you. You started off playing on tom- toms?
